title: Auditability Is Not One Property: Rule Overlap, Behavioural Agreement, and Composition in Reinforcement Learning

one_line_essence: 据摘要（arXiv 2609.28581）：Auditability 把 RL policy 审计拆为 6 个可独立测试的离散谓词——trace integrity / lossless coding / rule coverage / behavioral agreement / composition quality / value-model reliability——目标是让'opaque neural checkpoints'可以表示并组合为'auditable discrete behavioral rules'。这是 ai-agent × llm-evaluation × security-governance 的'审计协议工程化'资产：'auditability is not one property'是把单一口号拆为可逐项验证的协议集合，与昨日 TWIST（28575）'memory intervention quality'、DEEPO（28570）'RL correction chain 双熵治理'、28075 'Behavioral Stress Tests'形成'agent 可靠性 × 评估协议'连续主线——分别覆盖 memory 干预点评估、RL 内部熵治理、agent 行为级 reliability、RL 审计离散谓词化。代码/benchmark/项目页：暂无，需打开 PDF 看 6 个谓词的 protocol 形式化、composability theorem、独立训练 policy 的合成条件。今日动作：即时试点方向，写'auditability as 6 verifiable predicates'checklist 草稿，关注与同批 28565 'XAI RTL 渲染'的'评估协议诚信度'主线共振。
